lastCompletedStory.title: Extend PrdStory/PrdShape with acceptanceCriteria, notes, requires, review.lastVerdict and thread into DashboardData

nextStoryContext: US-001 was pure type widening. PrdStory now carries acceptanceCriteria, notes, requires; PrdShape carries review.lastVerdict. These flow into DashboardData.stories (per-story fields) and DashboardData.reviewLastVerdict. No UI renders them yet -- that is left for later stories. The readSnapshot pipeline passes them through transparently: prd.json is JSON-parsed and cast as PrdShape, so the new fields land in snap.stories[] without any extra parsing code.
